import json
from work import evaluate
p=json.load(open('policy.json'))
requests=json.load(open('requests.json'))
report=json.load(open('report.json'))
actual=[evaluate(r,p) for r in requests]
assert actual==report
assert all(set(r)=={'ok','config','error'} for r in actual)
probe_policy={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':8,'s':'base'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}
probes=[
 ({'layers':[{'i':'bad'},{'b':False,'s':''}],'environment':{'i':'-07'}},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':-7,'s':''},'error':None}),
 ({'layers':[{'i':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':8,'s':'base'},'error':None}),
 ({'layers':[{'i':True}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),
 ({'environment':{'i':'1e2'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
 ({'environment':{'b':'TRUE'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
 ({'environment':{'x':'1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'})
]
for request,expected in probes:
 result=evaluate(request,probe_policy)
 assert result==expected,(request,result,expected)
 assert set(result)=={'ok','config','error'}
print(json.dumps({'report_cases':len(actual),'boundary_cases':len(probes),'status':'passed'}))
